messages:
Rina: Quick post-launch triage: three items from support netted in the morning digest. Need quick split into bug vs enhancement and decide sprint placement.

Omar: paste IDs?

Rina: From support queue:
```
RD-9402  generation truncates mid-sentence for long prompts (CustM)
RD-9410  API: token-usage header missing in some retries (internal)
RD-9422  request preview UX: copy button hidden behind tooltip on narrow screens (multiple customers)
```

Bree: My read: RD-9402 looks like a regression -> P0. RD-9410 is infra/SDK edge case -> P1. RD-9422 is UX polish but high visibility -> enhancement, quick patch if low risk.

Kofi: SRE/infra note: RD-9410 traces show header lost when retry proxy strips custom headers on 502s. Quick mitigation is to preserve headers on retry in the proxy (small change). Full SDK fix will follow.

Omar: If RD-9402 is P0, what's the repro surface?

Bree: Support attached a 8k-token prompt that used to finish. Repro looks related to chunked attention windows; suspect kernel config regression after last runtime upgrade.

Rina: Proposal:
- Sprint 1 (this 10-day cycle): RD-9402 hotfix (owner: Bree), RD-9410 proxy mitigation (owner: Kofi) as config flip + PR, RD-9422 scoped design + tiny patch if safe.
- Sprint 2: follow-on SDK fix for RD-9410 and full QA for RD-9422.

Omar: Acceptance criteria for RD-9402: failing test in harness, fix landed behind feature flag, canary at 5% for 24h, and documented rollback plan.

Kofi: I can land the proxy flip today; will tag ops to monitor cost/latency.

Bree: I'll start the reproducer and ping eng-qa. Need ~2.5 dev-days for root cause + test.

CommsBot: Created ticket RD-9500: "post-launch split: RD-9402 hotfix + RD-9410 proxy mitigation" (created by Rina).

Rina: PM ask: can someone draft a one-paragraph customer note for CustM and a separate tweet/console blurb for broader visibility? Keep it transparent but non-alarming.

Omar: I can draft the CustM note: "We're investigating truncation for long prompts; hotfix targeted this sprint; we'll update within 48 hours."

Bree: I'll attach the failing prompt and repro instructions to RD-9402 by EOD.

Kofi: Will monitor proxy flip and post metrics to the triage channel.

Rina: Thanks team. We'll review in next daily stand and confirm assignments.

Omar: +1

Bree: +1
